risks: Behaviour change: callers expecting every note in one response now get 50.
Clients that ignore response headers cannot discover further pages.
trade_offs: Keyset over offset: stable under concurrent writes and O(page) per request, but no 'jump to page N'.
Header cursor over an envelope body: backward compatible, less discoverable.
failure_scenarios: A client passes a cursor from a deleted note: still works, since the cursor is just an id bound.
guardrails: limit is bounded to 1..200 and after must be >= 0 (422 otherwise).
Existing tests plus 6 new ones pass.
